name: Technique Detector
author: Vocal Monitor
description: Detects expressive vocal techniques live as independent yes/no signals — several can be true at once. Trained on GTSinger's phoneme-level technique annotations over the same acoustic features as the Register Detector: formant-corrected H1*-H2*, spectral tilt (H1-A3), harmonic richness (HRF) and the singer's power ratio (SPR). Tells you when the tone goes breathy or pulls into bright pharyngeal twang.
